decision_basis: GDF5/BMPR1A-ACVR2A receptor-reconstitution and BMP-SMAD function support a qualified exact relay, with weaker BMPR1A affinity retained as a boundary.
GDF5/BMPR1B receptor-specific binding and BMPR1B/type-II receptor signaling support the exact BMP relay and developmental function packet.
Mouse mesenchymal Bmpr1a/Acvr2a perturbation with pSMAD1/5/8, p38, and adipocyte-commitment outputs support the exact relay/function record.
IL17F receptor-complex binding/activation, ACT1/TRAF6 relay, and inflammatory functional assays support the exact IL-17 receptor packet.
